baselineExceptions.name: Conduit
baselineExceptions.classification: Not technically practical to preserve as functional equipment
baselineExceptions.reason: Baseline registers Conduit only during isDevelopmentRun; its original element exposes no electrical or thermal loads. No survival functionality exists to reproduce.

baselineExceptions.name: Portable NaN
baselineExceptions.reason: Original creative Portable NaN deliberately injects NaN resistance, temperature and heat into the simulation. Numerical fault-injection unit tests replace the world-corrupting debug item; it is not survival equipment.

families.implementation: Original MNA components, dynamic R/C/L, sources, separate terminals, loss/thermal failure, six-face multipart topology, original C-key covers with live internal circuits, actual overhead grids and transformer/pole/switch assemblies.
All seven source batteries; four solar variants and tracking/ghost terminals; wind/water, combustion, heat/steam/shaft generation and finite portable storage.

Original processing inventories/boosters, furnaces, thermal networks and rooms, heat exchanger/steam, shafts/clutches/flywheels/large machines, engines, chargers, miners, replicator, incubator, transporter and turret.
Original logic/analog/equations, sensors and controls, diodes/passives, fuse/breaker contacts, wireless/data loggers/meters/displays, MQTT, Modbus TCP and optional actual CC Lua peripheral.

Original OBJ/textures/icons, mounting frames, moving machinery/instruments, per-component screens and authoritative packets, lighting, audio and held models. Detailed per-family audits identify actual reviewed client runs.

Four original ores, original materials/tools/armor/resin/crops and contained hardware. 349 restored crafting variants with zero unresolved source crafting calls; 61 direct and 5 conditional processing operations independently checked.

Published BCCE engines, real item/fluid pipes, finite fuel/steam/shaft/electrical plant, bidirectional native MJ conversion and a real quarry constructing its frame and excavating iron ore from ELN electrical power.

limitations: The original development-only Conduit has no implemented source electrical/thermal function. It is excluded from ordinary equipment; the original deliberate Portable NaN debug item is replaced by isolated numerical fault-injection tests.

Legacy OpenComputers 1.7 APIs and IC2-only integration are not advertised as modern tested runtimes. The ComputerCraft probe is restored through optional CC: Tweaked 1.101.4; FE and the pinned BCCE native MJ bridge provide the tested energy adapters.

Original C-key node covers accept full collision-cube block models, including logs, glass, leaves and light-emitting blocks. Block entities, fluids and partial collision shapes are excluded. An unavailable mod cover retains its raw saved state and item data with a stone visual fallback.
Source creative prototypes remain identified as such. Registration counts and source recipe counts are not independent proof of functional completeness.
BCCE native linkage is pinned to published 8.0.23. Other BCCE versions and every engine/gate/machine combination are unverified. BCCE is not modified or embedded.

Client verification used an isolated integrated server and a QA-only host pacing agent. The agent and QA sources are excluded from the normal installable JAR. This is automated client testing, not a long manual survival/multiplayer campaign.

The component matrix distinguishes individual operating fixtures from implemented variants that share a tested runtime but have not been separately exercised. Broad modpack compatibility and every original localization/configuration option are not asserted.
